metadata.scenario: A potential customer calls to ask about the process for enrolling in yoga classes. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Helen Johnson. I wanted to ask about the process for enrolling in yoga classes. Hi, Helen! It's great to hear from you. Yoga classes? We don’t offer those specifically at CareFirst. Oh, I see. I thought you might have some wellness programs. We do specialize in skilled nursing, physical therapy, and personal care assistance. Right, I remember. But are there any wellness options you recommend? Yes, we can certainly provide some exercises and mobility training through our physical therapy program. That sounds interesting. How does that work? Our physical therapist, Dr. James Rodriguez, can create a personalized exercise plan that can incorporate elements similar to yoga. Oh, I’d love to do that! How do I get started? I can set up a consultation with Dr. Rodriguez to discuss your needs and goals. That would be perfect. When is he available? He’s available Monday through Friday. Would you prefer a morning or afternoon appointment? Morning would work better for me. Great! How about this upcoming Tuesday at 10 AM? Yes, that sounds good. Awesome! I’ll book that for you. What’s your preferred number for a reminder? You can use my cell, +13165552580. Perfect! I’ll send a reminder ahead of time. Thank you. Also, I might need some personal care assistance as my recovery continues. We can definitely assist with that. Our personal care services start at $28 per hour. That’s reasonable. Can you provide more details during the consultation? Absolutely! Dr. Rodriguez can discuss that with you as well. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, Helen! We’re here to support you. Is there anything else you need? No, that covers it. Looking forward to Tuesday! Great! Have a wonderful day, Helen. You too, bye! Bye!
